name: cart-button
title: Cart Button
description: Expand the cart to adjust quantities and see the total.
useCases: In a print catalog, a shopper adds the first copy and adjusts the quantity directly on the product card.
At a merchandise kiosk, a shopper removes an extra item. The app receives the new quantity and updates the order total.
task: Expand the cart to adjust quantities and see the total.
behavior: onAdd fires on increments and onQuantityChange receives the resulting total. Use the latter to synchronize the cart.
